title: Circular dependency warning
body: ### What version of Hono are you using? 4.12.27 ### What runtime/platform is your app running on? (with version if possible) npm 11.11.0 ### What steps can reproduce the bug? I'm building my Hono project with Rollup: ```js import commonjs from '@rollup/plugin-commonjs' import resolve from '@rollup/plugin-node-resolve' import typescript from '@rollup/plugin-typescript' import del from 'rollup-plugin-delete' import dotenv from 'dotenv' dotenv.config() export default { input: 'src/server.ts', output: [ { file: 'dist/server.js', format: 'esm', inlineDynamicImports: true, }, ], plugins: [ del({ targets: 'dist/*' }), resolve(), commonjs(), typescript({ tsconfig: './tsconfig.json', rootDir: 'src' }), ], } ``` Where I get the following warning: It does build, so this is a low priority bug but I'm reporting it either way cause it's not right. ### What is the expected behavior? The warning is right. ### What do you see instead? (!) Circular dependency node_modules/hono/dist/request.js -> node_modules/hono/dist/utils/body.js -> node_modules/hono/dist/request.js ### Additional information My tsconfig.json: ```ts { "compilerOptions": { // Environment setup & latest features "typeRoots": ["./node_modules/@types", "./src/cloudflow.d.ts"], "types": ["bun"], "target": "es2016", "module": "preserve", "moduleResolution": "bundler", // Best practices "strict": true, "skipLibCheck": true, "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true, "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true, "noImplicitOverride": true, "sourceMap": false, "declaration": false, "removeComments": false, "pretty": true, "rootDir": "src", "outDir": "dist" }, "include": ["src/**/*"] } ``` My package.json (relevant parts): ```json "scripts": { "dev": "rollup -c -w", "build": "rollup -c && prettier --write dist/*" }, "devDependencies": { "@rollup/plugin-commonjs": "^29.0.3", "@rollup/plugin-node-resolve": "^16.0.3", "@rollup/plugin-replace": "^6.0.3", "@rollup/plugin-typescript": "^12.3.0", "@types/bun": "^1.3.14", "dotenv": "^17.4.2", "prettier": "^3.9.4", "rollup": "^4.62.2", "rollup-plugin-delete": "^3.0.2", "tslib": "^2.8.1", "typescript": "^6.0.3" }, "dependencies": { "@google/genai": "^2.10.0", "hono": "^4.12.27", "hono-rate-limiter": "^0.5.3" } ```
